title: Digital Citizenship
summary: Learn about passwords and staying safe online.
objectives: Understand the importance of strong passwords

steps.boltSpeech: When we connect to the Internet, we enter a digital world.

content.text: Being a good Digital Citizen means staying safe and treating others with respect.

points.text: Keep your passwords a secret (except from parents/teachers).
Never share your real name, address, or school with strangers online.
If someone is mean online, don't reply. Tell a trusted adult.

steps.boltSpeech: Is this safe to share online?
steps.instructions: Sort into 'Safe to Share' or 'Keep Private'.
